description: This file defines the AssignmentsService class that manages CRUD operations and business logic related to 'assignments' within a session management system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting assignments, as well as asserting reviewer assignments, interfacing with a PostgreSQL database via query functions, and utilizing custom error classes.

classes.name: AssignmentsService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD and business logic for handling session assignments, including listing, retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and verification of reviewer assignments.

methods.name: _exists(table, id)
methods.description: Private helper method to check existence of a record in a specified table by ID.

methods.name: list({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, session_id, employee_id, reviewer_user_id })
methods.description: Lists assignments with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, optionally filtered by session, employee, and reviewer.

methods.name: getById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific assignment by its ID, throws NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: create(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new assignment record after validating the existence of related session, employee, and reviewer user; throws errors on invalid status or conflicts.

methods.name: update(id, payload)
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an assignment identified by ID; currently only 'status' is allowed to be changed.

methods.name: remove(id)
methods.description: Deletes an assignment by ID, returning the deleted ID or throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: assertReviewerAssignment({ session_id, employee_id, reviewer_user_id })
methods.description: Checks if a reviewer is assigned to a specific employee in a session; throws ConflictError if not assigned.

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^  async list({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, session_id, employee_id, reviewer_user_id }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ limit, offset, sortBy, sortDir, session_id, employee_id, reviewer_user_id })
